description: This file defines the TaskResourceRequests class used in Apache Spark to manage resource requests for tasks, including CPU and custom resources, within a resource management framework.

classes.name: TaskResourceRequests
classes.description: A class to manage a set of resource requests for Spark tasks, supporting addition of CPU and custom resources, and providing access to the requests.

methods.name: requests
methods.description: Returns all resource requests as a Scala Map.

methods.name: requestsJMap
methods.description: Returns all resource requests as a Java Map.

methods.name: cpus
methods.description: Adds a CPU resource request for the task.

methods.name: resource
methods.description: Adds a custom resource request (e.g., GPU, FPGA) with fractional support.

methods.name: addRequest
methods.description: Adds a pre-constructed TaskResourceRequest to the set.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the resource requests.
